name: styleseed
description: A design-method engine for making expert design decisions repeatable by coding agents, with project-owned rules and reviewable evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Expert design decisions, repeatable by coding agents
interface.longDescription: Make recorded expert decisions usable in coding-agent workflows: compile selected rules, preserve project choices, build, and inspect the result. Support expert judgment, not replace it; a passing score is not human acceptance.
defaultPrompt: Set up StyleSeed and build this UI with a verified design method.
Audit this screen with StyleSeed and fix the highest-impact drift.
